title: Bilateral cooperation and MOUs

zh-TW.reviewer: 國際合作組中文審核人

summary: Taiwan CDC cooperates bilaterally with the United States, Japan, the European Union and New Southbound partners on emerging infections, laboratories, TB, dengue and migrant health.

partners.name: Japan (Japan–Taiwan Exchange Association / Taiwan–Japan Relations Association)

partnersNote: Partner topics and statuses are illustrative; signing years are left blank until confirmed.
bodyMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC works with partner countries and regions through memoranda of understanding (MOUs), cooperation arrangements between representative offices, and joint projects.

| Country / partner | Cooperation topics | Year signed | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| United States (AIT–TECRO framework) | Emerging infectious diseases; Laboratory capacity; Field epidemiology; GCTF workshops | — | Active |
| Japan (Japan–Taiwan Exchange Association / Taiwan–Japan Relations Association) | Surveillance information exchange; Vaccine-preventable diseases; Emerging infections | — | Active |
| European Union | Antimicrobial resistance; Preparedness expert exchanges | — | Active (expert exchanges) |
| Philippines (New Southbound partner) | Tuberculosis control; Migrant worker health; Laboratory training | — | Active |
| Viet Nam (New Southbound partner) | Dengue and vector control; Migrant worker health | — | Active |
| Thailand (New Southbound partner) | Dengue; Malaria; Border health | — | Under discussion |
| Indonesia (New Southbound partner) | Pre-departure health checks; Tuberculosis | — | Under discussion |
| India (New Southbound partner) | Laboratory and vaccine research exchanges | — | Planned |

## New Southbound health cooperation
Under the New Southbound Policy, Taiwan CDC cooperates with partners in South and Southeast Asia on tuberculosis, dengue and other vector-borne diseases, migrant worker health and laboratory capacity, and welcomes their health officials to training programs in Taiwan.

> Partner topics and statuses are illustrative in this prototype, and signing years are left blank until the Division of International Cooperation confirms them (dates are recorded by year when published).

## 新南向醫衛合作
依新南向政策，疾管署與南亞及東南亞夥伴在結核病、登革熱等病媒傳染病、移工健康與實驗室能力等領域合作，並邀請夥伴國衛生官員來臺參加訓練。

> 本原型中的合作主題與狀態為示意，簽署年待國際合作組確認後以「年度」登錄，目前留空。
